description.value: Jun Yuan Restaurant is an all-you-can-eat Chinese hotpot restaurant specializing in broths simmered for over five hours from scratch, alongside a vast selection of fresh meats, handmade fish puffs, seafood, and vegetables. The founder has over 20 years in the food industry and developed the restaurant's signature handmade fish tofu (魚腐), a Cantonese Shunde tradition, which became popular enough to supply local supermarkets and restaurants. Chicken wing takeout combos are also available for cyclists looking for a quick, portable meal.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces, covered) at 97m; stands (2 spaces, covered) at 99m. Total: 4 spaces.
